justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/Newlines.java` (lines 157-199) and `core/src/test/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/NewlinesTest.java`. `LineIterator` is a private nested helper with one constructor and three behavioral methods (`advance`, `hasNext`, `next`) plus `remove`; it only iterates over line substrings and delegates offset logic to `lineOffsetIterator`, so it shows a narrow, cohesive responsibility rather than insufficient modularization.
